# eon_backup_posture_controls (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of backup posture controls in the Eon project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List all backup posture controls
data "eon_backup_posture_controls" "all" {}

# Example: Filter high-severity controls
locals {
  high_severity_controls = [
    for control in data.eon_backup_posture_controls.all.controls :
    control if control.severity == "HIGH"
  ]
}

output "backup_posture_controls_count" {
  description = "Total number of backup posture controls"
  value       = length(data.eon_backup_posture_controls.all.controls)
}

output "high_severity_controls_count" {
  description = "Number of high-severity backup posture controls"
  value       = length(local.high_severity_controls)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `controls` (Attributes List) List of backup posture controls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--controls))

<a id="nestedatt--controls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `controls`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Backup posture control ID.
- `name` (String) Backup posture control display name.
- `resource_selection_mode` (String) Mode that determines how resources are selected for the control. Possible values: `ALL`, `NONE`, `CONDITIONAL`.
- `severity` (String) Severity assigned to the control. Possible values: `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`.
